reason.en: Correct fact but misassigned to principal rather than interest obligation.
reason.zh: 事实正确但错误用于本金而非利息义务。

highlights.text: devised the farm to his surviving widow for life with remainder in fee simple to his three children

reason.en: Creates the successive interests that determine who pays mortgage interest versus principal.
reason.zh: 确立先后相继权益，从而决定利息与本金由谁负担。

highlights.text: installment of principal and interest due on the mortgage

reason.en: Triggers the rule that life tenants pay interest and remaindermen pay principal.
reason.zh: 触发终身租户付利息、剩余权人付本金的规则。

highlights.text: $25,000 net after paying all expenses and charges except the installment of principal and interest due on the mortgage

reason.en: Shows the widow has sufficient income to cover her interest duty but not principal.
reason.zh: 表明遗孀收益足以付利息但不足以替代子女的本金义务。

highlights.text: the widow should pay all of these amounts out of the profits she had made in operation of the farm

reason.en: States the daughter's incorrect theory that the life tenant must pay principal too.
reason.zh: 陈述女儿关于终身租户须付本金的错误主张。

highlights.text: foreclosure of the mortgage seemed imminent

reason.en: Explains the urgency for remaindermen to protect their interests by paying principal.
reason.zh: 说明剩余权人须及时偿付本金以保护权益的紧迫性。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
By deed, a landowner conveyed land to a charity "on the condition that the land be used as a wildlife refuge, and if not, the landowner and his heirs may enter and terminate the estate hereby created." The following year the landowner died. His sister was his sole heir. By will, the landowner devised "all of my real property interests to my friend." One year after the landowner's death, the sister, by quitclaim deed, conveyed any interest she had in the land to a developer. Two years after the landowner's death, the landowner's sister died. Her sole heir was her husband. Recently, three years after the landowner's death, the charity ceased to use the land as a wildlife refuge.
Who may properly bring an action against the charity to recover fee simple ownership of the land?

choices.A: The developer.
choices.B: The landowner's friend.
choices.C: The sister's husband.
choices.D: No one.

questions.explanation:
Landowner
FSSCS
“to the charity on the condition that if the land is not used as a wildlife refuge”
Right of entry
“the landowner and his heirs may enter and terminate the estate”
Devise
“devised all of my real property interests to my friend”
FSSCS = Fee simple subject to condition subsequent.

A fee simple subject to a condition subsequent (FSSCS) is created through specific conditional language, such as “but if” or “on the condition that.” Upon the occurrence of the condition, the grantor (or his/her successor in interest) has the right to enter and terminate the estate if the grantor explicitly retained this right of entry† in the conveyance. The right of entry is fully transferable upon death – meaning that it is devisable by will or descendible through intestate succession – but in most states it is not alienable during life.

Here, the landowner conveyed an FSSCS to the charity and retained a right of entry that could be exercised if the land was no longer used as a wildlife refuge. The landowner then devised all of his real property interests – including the right of entry – to his friend. And since the charity recently ceased to use the land as a wildlife refuge, the friend can exercise the right of entry and bring an action to recover ownership of the land (Choice D).

†This right is also known as the “power of termination” or the “right of reentry.”

(Choices A & C) The landowner devised all of his real property interests to the friend, leaving no interest in the land for the sister to inherit upon his death. Because the sister had no interest in the land to convey to the developer by quitclaim deed or for her husband to inherit upon her death, neither of them may bring an action to recover ownership of the land from the charity.

📌 Educational Objective

The grantor of a fee simple subject to a condition subsequent can explicitly retain a right of entry, which allows the grantor (or his/her successor in interest) to enter and terminate the estate if the stated condition occurs. This right is devisable by will and descendible through intestate succession.

📚 References
  • Restatement (First) of Property § 45 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (fee simple subject to a condition subsequent).
  • Restatement (First) of Property § 155 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (power of termination or right of entry).
questions.zh-question:
一位土地所有者通过契据将土地转让给一个慈善机构，“条件是该土地被用作野生动物庇护所，否则，该土地所有者及其继承人可以进入并终止由此设立的地产权。”次年，该土地所有者去世。他的妹妹是其唯一继承人。通过遗嘱，该土地所有者将“我所有的不动产权益”遗赠给了他的朋友。在土地所有者去世一年后，其妹妹通过免责契据，将其在该土地上拥有的任何权益转让给了一位开发商。在土地所有者去世两年后，其妹妹去世。她的唯一继承人是她的丈夫。最近，在土地所有者去世三年后，该慈善机构停止将该土地用作野生动物庇护所。

谁可以合法地对该慈善机构提起诉讼，以收回该土地的完全保有产权（fee simple ownership）？

zh-choices.A: 该开发商。
zh-choices.B: 该土地所有者的朋友。
zh-choices.C: 该妹妹的丈夫。
zh-choices.D: 无人可以。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Present estates & future interests

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：fee simple subject to condition subsequent（附条件后费用简单继承权）里保留的 right of entry（进入并终止权），到底是谁能在条件触发后起诉要回土地。

三秒认题路径：

条件用地 → 保留进入权 → 能否继承/遗赠 → 条件已违背 → 谁能起诉

核心法律规则

fee simple subject to a condition subsequent（附条件后继承权）的关键不是“自动没收”，而是“条件发生后，权利人可以选择进入并终止”。

right of entry（进入权）也叫 power of termination 或 right of reentry；考试里它通常可以随死亡通过遗嘱处分或按无遗嘱继承传下去。

所以这题只看一点：土地所有人死前已经把自己“所有不动产权益”遗赠给朋友，朋友就拿到这把钥匙；后来条件被违反时，朋友可以直接来终止该地产并要回土地。

核心判例： Restatement (First) of Property §§ 45, 155：保留的进入权可以因遗嘱而转移，条件触发后由受让人主张收回土地。

思维导图

地主 先把土地给 charity
→
charity 拿到土地，但受条件限制
→
保留的进入权 条件违背时可终止 estate
→
遗嘱给朋友 “all of my real property interests”
→
朋友赢 条件触发后直接起诉收回
条件已经违背了吗？
YES：进入权被触发，但要看谁持有这把权利钥匙。
谁持有：地主已把全部不动产权益遗赠给朋友，女儿/继承人并没有剩余权益可再转让。
结论：朋友可起诉恢复 fee simple ownership。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：地主死后，先想到他的姐姐是法定继承人，所以姐姐、姐姐的受让人、甚至姐姐的丈夫都能去告。

但考试真正问的是：地主生前已经把 所有 real property interests 遗赠给朋友，姐姐手里根本没有这块地可再转给别人。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「事实看起来谁和土地关系更近」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

地主把 all of my real property interests 都遗赠给朋友，包含这份 right of entry（进入权）；条件后来被触发，所以朋友能起诉收回土地。

❌ 事实误判 | 继承链偷换

✕ A: 把 quitclaim deed 当成有效来源，但姐姐根本没拿到这份权利。

❌ 法律适用 | 继承人误接权利

✕ C: 以为丈夫能顺着姐姐的继承链拿权，可姐姐已无可继承的土地权益。

❌ 概念混淆 | 自动没收误判

✕ D: 把条件违背误当成没人能告的自动归零，其实是进入权持有人来终止。

这题建议用什么方法？

先找地产类型，再追 right of entry（进入权） 的转移链，最后看条件是否已触发。

考场速记

记住一句：FSSCS 不是自动没收，right of entry 可以随遗嘱传给继受人；条件一触发，拿到这把钥匙的人就能起诉收回。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A borrower, who is a citizen of State A, defaults on a loan secured by a mortgage on undeveloped land located in State B. The borrower executed the loan in State B and regularly transacts business there. The lender, who is a citizen of State B, sues the borrower in a state court in State A for the outstanding loan obligation before seeking to foreclose on the property. Under the laws of State A, a lender may sue the borrower directly on the debt before foreclosing on mortgaged property. Under the laws of State B, a lender must foreclose on the property before suing the borrower.
The court in State A determines that the conflict-of-laws rules of its own state should apply and that, under those rules, State B has the most significant relationship to the loan, the lender, and the borrower.
Should the court apply State A law or State B law regarding the lender's right to sue the borrower directly on the outstanding debt?

choices.A: State A law, because the borrower is a citizen of State A.
choices.B: State A law, because the court is located in State A.
choices.C: State B law, because State B has the most significant relationship to this matter.
choices.D: State B law, because the loan was originated in State B.

questions.explanation:
Conflict-of-laws rule for real property issues
General rule In cases involving real property, law applied by forum court should be determined by conflict-of-laws rule that would be applied by state where property is located
Exceptions
  • Document specifies application of specific jurisdiction's laws
  • Issues regarding effect of marriage on interest in land
  • Collateral issues (eg, whether transferor perpetrated fraud)
  • Issues regarding mortgage note (eg, validity of note)
  • Foreclosure-related issues that do not affect interest in land (eg, mortgagee's right to sue mortgagor for underlying debt before foreclosure)

Conflict-of-laws issues arise when significant aspects of a legal action are divided between two or more states, creating a conflict as to which state's law applies (as seen here). If the conflict involves real property, the general rule is that the law applied by the forum court should be determined by the conflict-of-laws rule that would be applied by the courts of the situs state—ie, the state where the property is located. Usually, the conflict-of-laws rule of the situs state calls for the application of its own local law on that issue (ie, the law of the situs).

However, this general rule does not apply to issues that are related to foreclosure but do not affect an interest in land—eg, a lender's right to sue a borrower on the outstanding debt before foreclosure (as seen here). Instead, such issues are determined by the law that governs the debt for which the mortgage was given, which is the law of the state that has the most significant relationship to the transaction and the parties (here, State B).

(Choice A) The borrower is a citizen of State A, so the State A court has personal jurisdiction over the borrower. But this does not mean that the State A court should apply State A law regarding the lender's right to sue the borrower before foreclosing on the mortgaged property.

(Choices B & D) Although the court is located in State A and the loan was originated in State B, the dispositive factor is which state has the most significant relationship to the issue at hand.

📌 Educational Objective

Issues that relate to foreclosure but do not affect an interest in land—eg, a lender's right to sue the borrower before foreclosing on the mortgaged property—are determined by the law of the state with the most significant relationship to the transaction and the parties.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Conflict of Laws § 223, cmt. i (Am. Law Inst. 1971) (validity and effect of conveyance of interest in land).
questions.zh-question:
一名借款人，其为A州的公民，对一笔以位于B州的未开发土地的抵押权作担保的贷款违约。该借款人在B州签订了该贷款合同，并常于该地进行商业交易。贷款人是B州的公民，在寻求对该财产进行止赎之前，于A州的一家州法院就未偿还的贷款债务起诉了该借款人。根据A州的法律，贷款人可以在对抵押财产进行止赎前，直接就该债务起诉借款人。根据B州的法律，贷款人必须在起诉借款人之前先对该财产进行止赎。

A州的法院认定，应适用其本州的法律冲突规则，并且根据这些规则，B州与该贷款、贷款人和借款人具有最密切的联系。

关于贷款人是否有权就未偿还的债务直接起诉借款人这一问题，法院应适用A州法律还是B州法律？

zh-choices.A: A州法律，因为借款人是A州的公民。
zh-choices.B: A州法律，因为法院位于A州。
zh-choices.C: B州法律，因为B州与此案具有最密切的联系。
zh-choices.D: B州法律，因为该财产位于B州。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Special Real Property Issues

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：当抵押房产在州 B、但原告先起诉未清偿债务时，法院要按最密切联系（most significant relationship）来决定能不能直接追债，而不是看法院在哪州或当事人是哪个州公民。

三秒认题路径：

抵押房产 → 先追债 → 非终局争点 → 看最密切联系 → 选州 B

核心法律规则

这题只看哪条冲突法规则

涉及不动产（real property）时，法院地法（forum court law）通常要先看房产所在地法（law of the situs）的冲突法规则，考场意思：先问房子在哪州，再看那州会不会用自己法。

但如果争点只是抵押前先追债（foreclosure-related issue not affecting interest in land），那就不按房产所在地硬套，而是看最密切联系（most significant relationship）的州法，考场意思：这次问的是债务规则，不是土地所有权规则。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Conflict of Laws § 223 的思路锁定本题：和土地权利本身无关的先追债问题，要回到与交易和当事人联系最紧的州。

思维导图

先问：这是在改动土地本身的权利吗？
不是。 题目说的是先起诉借款人追未清偿债务，不是先判断能不能把州 B 的土地卖掉。
规则切换。 这种foreclosure-related但不影响土地权益的问题，不走“房产所在地法硬套”。
卡死点：看州 A 法院自己的冲突法，再落到与贷款、当事人联系最紧的州法。
事实落点。 贷款在州 B 签、借款人在州 B 反复交易、州 B 与交易和双方联系最强。
结论。 应适用州 B 法，所以贷方能否直接追债，要按州 B 的规则看。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：借款人是州 A 公民，州 A 法院也在州 A，所以当然用州 A 法。

但考试真正问的是：这个争点到底在管土地权益，还是只在管抵押债务的先后顺序。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这里真正决定答案的是“谁和这笔贷款最有联系”，不是“谁被告到哪州法院”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干已明确州 A 采用自己的冲突法，而该冲突法指向州 B；又因为争点只是先追债，州 B 与贷款和双方的联系最强，所以适用州 B 法。

❌ 概念混淆 | 公民身份误判

✕ A: 把citizen当成选法标准了。

❌ 法律适用 | 法院所在地误判

✕ B: 只看court is located，忽略冲突法已经把你带走了。

❌ 事实误判 | 起草地点偷换

✕ D: 只盯着originated in，却漏掉“最密切联系”才是决定点。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清是在管土地还是管债务，再用冲突法把“州 B 联系最强”这条线直接锁死。

考场速记

记住这句：不动产先看 situs，先追债再看最密切联系。只要题目写的是“foreclosure before suing”，先别被法院所在地和公民身份带跑。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A woman died and in her duly probated will devised a tract of land to her son "for life" and then to "the heirs of his body in fee simple absolute." The son used the tract to secure a loan from a bank. When the son defaulted on the debt, the bank initiated foreclosure proceedings. A buyer acquired the tract at the foreclosure sale and promptly sold the tract to a friend. Both the buyer's deed and the friend's deed referenced the woman's will for the description of the parcel, and both deeds were promptly recorded.
Twenty years later, the son died intestate, leaving two children as his only heirs. The children have sued the friend, claiming ownership of the land under a 30-year marketable title act.
If common law rules have not been modified in the jurisdiction, who will likely prevail?

choices.A: The children, because the friend acquired the son's life estate, which terminated when the son died.
choices.B: The children, because the friend's deed referenced the woman's will, which served as a notice of claim under the marketable title act.
choices.C: The friend, because the children failed to record a notice of claim.
choices.D: The friend, because the friend acquired the son's interest in fee simple absolute.

questions.explanation:
Woman
“to my son for life”
Life estate to son
“then to the heirs of his body in fee simple absolute”
Remainder to son (Rule in Shelley’s Case)
Son Fee simple absolute (Merger rule)
Son Fee simple absolute
foreclosure
Buyer Fee simple absolute
Friend Fee simple absolute

Under the common law, the Rule in Shelley’s Case applies when an instrument grants:

  • a freehold estate (eg, life estate) to a person and
  • a remainder to the same person’s heirs or the heirs of that person’s body.

When this occurs, that person is considered to hold the freehold estate AND the remainder, so the person’s heirs take nothing under the granting instrument. And under the doctrine of merger, if there is no intervening interest, the freehold estate and the remainder merge so that the person takes in fee simple absolute (FSA).

Here, the woman’s will devised a life estate to the son and the remainder to the heirs of his body. The son is therefore considered to hold the life estate and the remainder. Since there is no intervening interest (eg, had another life estate followed the son’s life estate), the son’s interests merged into an FSA that the buyer acquired at the foreclosure sale and subsequently conveyed to the friend. Therefore, the friend will likely prevail.

Had this jurisdiction abolished the Rule in Shelley’s Case (as most others have done), the parties would have taken the freehold estate and remainder in accordance with the language in the deed. This means that the son would have received a life estate—subsequently acquired by the buyer and then the friend—that would have terminated upon the son’s death. And the children would have received the remainder and therefore prevailed (Choice A).

(Choices B & C) Marketable title acts extinguish any title defects that have not been recorded within the statutory period (here, 30 years). Since the buyer’s and friend’s recorded deeds referenced the granting language from the woman’s will, this likely satisfied the act’s recording requirement. However, the children still have no claim to enforce.

📌 Educational Objective

Under the Rule in Shelley’s Case, an instrument that grants a freehold estate to a person and a remainder to that same person’s heirs gives that person both interests. If there is no intervening interest, then the merger rule consolidates those interests into a fee simple absolute.
questions.zh-question:
一名女性去世，在其经正式遗嘱认证的遗嘱中，她将一块土地遗赠给她的儿子“终身”，然后遗赠给“其直系血亲继承人，以绝对无条件继承方式”。儿子用这块土地向银行申请贷款作为担保。当儿子拖欠债务时，银行启动了止赎程序。一名买方在止赎拍卖中购得该土地，并迅速将土地出售给一位朋友。买方的地契和朋友的地契在描述地块时都引用了该女性的遗嘱，并且两份地契都已及时登记。

二十年后，儿子未立遗嘱而亡，留下两个孩子作为其唯一继承人。孩子们根据一项30年的可售卖产权法起诉了这位朋友，主张土地的所有权。

如果该司法管辖区的普通法规则未被修改，谁可能会胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 孩子们，因为朋友获得的是儿子的终身地产权，该权利在儿子去世时即告终止。
zh-choices.B: 孩子们，因为朋友的地契引用了该女性的遗嘱，这根据可售卖产权法构成了权利主张的通知。
zh-choices.C: 朋友，因为孩子们未能登记权利主张通知。
zh-choices.D: 朋友，因为朋友获得的是儿子在绝对无条件继承下的权益。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Future interests

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：Rule in Shelley's Case（雪利案规则）配合merger（合并），看受让人最后是不是拿到fee simple absolute（完全所有权）。

三秒认题路径：

终身地产 + 后嗣剩余 → 雪利案规则 → 合并 → FSA → 卖家赢

核心法律规则

当文书先给某人life estate（终身地产），又给同一人的 heirs / heirs of his body（其继承人/血亲后嗣）时，Rule in Shelley's Case（雪利案规则）会把这两层利益都算到这个人头上。考场意思：这人不是只拿“活着时的使用权”，而是同时拿到了未来利益。

如果中间没有别的利益插进来，merger（合并）就把这两个利益并成fee simple absolute（完全所有权）。所以本题里，儿子后来被视为已经拿到 FSA，银行止赎卖给买家后，买家再卖给朋友，朋友当然接得住。

核心判例： Rule in Shelley's Case 与 merger 联动的老规则，锁定结论：先给终身地产、再给同一人的后嗣，常会直接变成完全所有权。

思维导图

女人遗嘱 “to my son for life” + “heirs of his body”
→
雪利案规则 同一人同时拿 life estate + remainder
→
儿子 先被视为持有完整两层利益
→
合并规则 无中间利益就并成 FSA
→
银行止赎买家 拿到 fee simple absolute
→
朋友 继续拿 fee simple absolute，胜诉

考点陷阱

你可能会想：儿子只是life estate，他一死，孩子就该接回去。

但考试真正问的是：遗嘱在普通法下先触发了Rule in Shelley's Case（雪利案规则），儿子其实已经把终身地产和剩余利益一起拿走了。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。（本题对应地，考的是产权链条有没有被规则提前改写，不是表面上“谁活到最后”）

别被“孩子是继承人”带跑：只有在规则被废除时，孩子才会真的拿到剩余权益；题干明确说普通法未被修改，所以这条路直接断掉。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的“for life”加“heirs of his body”正好触发雪利案规则，再经合并变成 FSA，所以买家和朋友都拿到完整所有权。

❌ 事实误判 | 终身地产误读

✕ A: 把儿子当成只剩life estate，漏掉规则已经把剩余也算给他了。

❌ 法律适用 | 录告知错位

✕ B: 盯着notice of claim，却忽略题目先被普通法规则改写了产权。

❌ 概念混淆 | 未登记混同

✕ C: 把“没登记”当成孩子能翻盘的关键，但他们本来就没剩余可主张。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看普通法未来利益怎么落到同一人头上，再问有没有中间利益挡住合并。

考场速记

记忆口诀：“life estate + heirs of his body” 先想Shelley's Case，再想merger；没中间利益，就很容易直接滚成 fee simple absolute（完全所有权）。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
An individual devised a wooded parcel of land to her two children, a daughter and a son, with the daughter being given a 75 percent interest in the land and the son a 25 percent interest. The daughter intends to harvest timber from the land without seeking permission from her brother, whom she knows would object to altering the parcel from its natural state.
How much of the timber on the land is the daughter entitled to harvest?

choices.A: All of the timber, because a cotenant is entitled to all of the natural resources on the co-owned land.
choices.B: Seventy-five percent, because the daughter is only entitled to the share of natural resources that corresponds with her ownership interest in the land.
choices.C: Fifty percent, because the daughter is a tenant in common.
choices.D: None, unless the brother consents.

questions.explanation:
Rights & duties of cotenants
Rights
  • Possess & enjoy entire property
  • Receive proportionate shares of net profits from removal of natural resources
  • Receive pro rata shares of rent from third parties
Duties
  • Pay proportionate shares of expenses that may give rise to lien (eg, mortgage, property tax)
  • Contribute to repair or improvement costs, but only upon agreement

A concurrent estate (ie, cotenancy ) arises when two or more persons own real property at the same time. In any cotenancy, the cotenants have certain rights and duties — including the right to possess the entire property, regardless of the size of their ownership interests. However, each cotenant's right to natural resources found on the land (eg, minerals, oil, gas, timber — as seen here) is limited to the size of the cotenant's interest in the land (Choice A).

Here, the son and the daughter are cotenants with respect to the wooded parcel of land. The daughter's share of the cotenancy is 75 percent, so she is entitled to harvest 75 percent of the timber on the land — regardless of whether her brother consents (Choice D).

(Choice C) The daughter and the son have a tenancy in common, as evidenced by the fact that they did not take the land in equal shares. But the daughter is entitled to harvest 75 percent of the timber (not 50 percent) because that is the size of her ownership interest.

📌 Educational Objective

Each cotenant's right to natural resources on the land (eg, timber) is limited to the size of the cotenant's ownership interest.

📚 References
  • 20 Am. Jur. 2d Cotenancy and Joint Ownership § 43 (2020) (use and enjoyment—timber).

一个人将一块林地遗赠给她的两个孩子，一个女儿和一个儿子，其中女儿获得了该土地75%的权益，儿子获得了25%的权益。

女儿打算未经其兄弟许可，采伐这片土地上的木材。

女儿有权采伐这片土地上多少木材？

zh-choices.A: 所有的木材，因为土地的共有人有权获得该土地上的所有自然资源。
zh-choices.B: 百分之七十五，因为这个数量与她在这片土地上的所有权权益相对应。
zh-choices.C: 百分之五十，因为她是按份共有人（tenant in common）。
zh-choices.D: 一点也不能，除非她的兄弟同意。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Cotenancy

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：共有产权（cotenancy）里，天然资源（natural resources）的处分收益只能按各自份额来分，不能因为你想砍树就把整片林子都拿走。

三秒认题路径：

两人同享土地 → 看到木材 → 先看份额 → 再限收益 → 选 75%

核心法律规则

两个或以上的人同时拥有同一块不动产，就是共有产权（cotenancy），其中每个共有人都可以占有并使用整块土地，考场意思：你不能因为自己只占一部分，就只能进一小块地。

但对天然资源（natural resources），比如木材、矿产、石油、天然气，规则更细：能拿走的收益只按自己的产权份额算，考场意思：你能分到多少树，不看你想不想砍，而看你在地里占多少。

所以这题里，女儿是 75% 共有人，她最多只能收获 75% 的木材；兄弟会不会同意，不改变她的份额上限。

核心判例： 无需特定判例；本题直接套用共有产权下天然资源按份额分配的常规规则。

思维导图

遗嘱赠与土地 同一块 wooded parcel
→
女儿 75% 共有人份额最大
→
木材收益上限 只能按 75% 取走
→
兄弟反对 不改份额规则
→
正确答案 B 75% timber
速判链： 看到 共有产权（cotenancy） → 看到 timber → 先问产权份额 → 不是全拿 → 按 75% 限制。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然共有人都能使用整块地，那女儿是不是也能把整片木材都砍走。

但考试真正问的是：自然资源收益能不能超过她的产权份额，答案是不能。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这题最容易把“可占有整块土地”误成“可独占全部木材”，其实前者讲的是使用权，后者讲的是资源收益，两个不是一回事。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干 75 percent interest 已经把她的份额写死了，所以她只能按 75% 收获 timber，兄弟反对也不改变上限。

❌ 概念混淆 | 全取资源误判

✕ A: 把“可占有整块地”偷换成“可拿走全部木材”。

❌ 法律适用 | 一律平分误判

✕ C: 看到 tenancy in common 就硬套 50/50，但题干明写 75/25。

❌ 事实误判 | 同意条件偷换

✕ D: 把兄弟不同意当成限制条件，其实资源份额不靠同意决定。

这题建议用什么方法？

先锁定“共有产权 + 天然资源”这个组合，再直接按份额算收益，不被“整块占有”带偏。

考场速记

口诀：“整块地可用，资源按份分；看份额，不看谁先动手。”

这类题一看到 timber、minerals、oil、gas，先问产权比例，再问能拿多少，不要先被“能占有整块土地”骗走。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man owned in fee simple Lots 1 and 2 in an urban subdivision. The lots were vacant and unproductive. They were held as a speculation that their value would increase. The man died and, by his duly probated will, devised the residue of his estate (of which Lots 1 and 2 were part) to his wife for life with remainder in fee simple to his sister. The man's executor distributed the estate under appropriate court order and notified the wife that future real estate taxes on Lots 1 and 2 were her responsibility to pay.
Except for the statutes relating to probate and those relating to real estate taxes, there is no applicable statute.
The wife left the lots vacant and did not pay the real estate taxes due for Lots 1 and 2. To prevent a tax sale of the fee simple, the sister paid the taxes and demanded that the wife reimburse her for same. When the wife refused, the sister brought an appropriate action against the wife to recover the amount paid.
In such action, what should the sister recover?

choices.A: Nothing, because the wife never received any income from the lots.
choices.B: Nothing, because the wife's sole possession gave the right to decide whether or not taxes should be paid.
choices.C: The amount paid, because a life tenant has the duty to pay current charges.
choices.D: The present value of the interest that the amount paid would earn during the wife's lifetime.

questions.explanation:
Life tenant's duties
Duty to pay current charges Life tenant must pay all current charges due during life tenancy (eg, property taxes, mortgage interest) up to financial benefit received from property
Duty to prevent waste Life tenant must prevent affirmative waste (ie, voluntary waste), permissive waste & ameliorative waste
Duty to make ordinary repairs Life tenant must make reasonable repairs to preserve property

The holder of a life estate (ie, the life tenant) has a duty to pay current charges on the land that become due during the life tenancy (eg, property taxes, mortgage interest). But this duty is limited to the financial benefit that the life tenant receives from the property. Therefore, there is no duty to pay these charges if the life tenant is not in possession of the property and does not receive rent or other income from the property.

Here, the man's wife received a life estate ("to his wife for life") and the remainder was owned by his sister ("remainder in fee simple to his sister"). Although a life tenant generally has the duty to pay real estate taxes, the lots were left vacant and unproductive. As a result, the wife received no financial benefit from the lots and had no duty to pay the real estate taxes. The sister should therefore recover nothing.

(Choice B) The wife's duty to pay taxes depends on the financial benefit she received from the land, not merely her possession of it.

(Choices C & D) Had the wife been obligated to pay the real estate taxes, the sister could have recovered the amount paid and possibly the interest that accrued during the repayment period (but not during the wife's lifetime).

📌 Educational Objective

A life tenant's duty to pay current charges on the land is limited to the financial benefit that the life tenant receives from the property. Therefore, this duty is not owed if the life tenant is not in possession of and receives no income from the property.

📚 References
  • Restatement (First) of Property §§ 129–130 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (duty to pay current charges).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子以完全保有地权的形式拥有城市分区中的地块1（Lot 1）和地块2（Lot 2）。这些地块空置且无产出，被持有用于投机，期望其价值会上涨。该男子去世，通过其经正式遗嘱检验的遗嘱，将其剩余遗产（包括地块1和地块2）遗赠给其妻子，授予其终身保有权，剩余权益则以完全保有地权的形式遗赠给其妹妹。该男子的遗嘱执行人根据适当的法院命令分配了遗产，并通知其妻子，地块1和地块2未来的房产税应由她负责支付。

除与遗嘱检验和房产税相关的法规外，没有其他适用的法规。

妻子让这些地块保持空置，并且没有支付地块1和地块2到期的房产税。为防止该完全保有地权因欠税被出售，妹妹支付了税款，并要求妻子偿还该笔款项。当妻子拒绝后，妹妹对妻子提起了适当的诉讼，以追回其支付的款项。

在此诉讼中，妹妹应能获得多少赔偿？

zh-choices.A: 无，因为妻子从未从这些地块中获得任何收入。
zh-choices.B: 无，因为妻子的单独占有权使其有权决定是否应支付税款。
zh-choices.C: 支付的金额，因为终身保有人有责任支付当期费用。
zh-choices.D: 在妻子有生之年，已支付金额所能产生的利息的现值。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Present estates

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：终身地产（life estate）的当前费用（current charges）义务，是否会因为受益人没有从土地获得收入而消失。

三秒认题路径：

终身地产 → 付税义务 → 看收益 → 没收入 → 不用赔

核心法律规则

持有终身地产（life estate）的人，通常要支付其占有期间产生的当前费用（current charges），比如地税和房贷利息；但考场意思是：这个义务只到她从房产拿到的财务利益（financial benefit）为止。

所以，如果她没有实际占有、也没有收租或其他收入，current charges 就不会逼她自己掏钱。对这题来说，关键不是“她是不是名义上的 life tenant”，而是“她有没有从这块地拿到钱”。

核心判例： Restatement (First) of Property §§ 129–130：终身地产承担当前费用，但只在其获得财务收益的范围内承担。

思维导图

1. 先看身份
妻子拿到for life，确实是 life tenant。
2. 再看收费类型
这里是real estate taxes，属于current charges。
3. 关键卡点
地块一直空置、无租金、无其他收入，没有财务利益。
4. 结论
没有收益就没有这笔付税义务，姐姐替她垫付后也追不回。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：她既然是 life tenant，就应该自动负责把税交掉。

但考试真正问的是：她有没有从这块地拿到财务收益（financial benefit），而不是她有没有“坐在名义上的位置”。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干明确说两块地长期空置、无收入，never received any income，所以妻子没有达到要自己承担税费的触发线，姐姐不能追回代付金额。

❌ 概念混淆 | 只看占有

✕ B: 把sole possession当成付税标准，忽略了要看收益。

❌ 法律适用 | 绝对义务化

✕ C: 直接把duty to pay current charges说成无条件全额义务。

❌ 事实误判 | 利息范围偷换

✕ D: 只有真有可追偿的本金时才谈present value，本题前提就没欠费。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“有没有收益”，再决定当前费用义务是否成立；不要把“生命地产”误读成“天然必付税”。

考场速记

记住一句：life tenant 付 current charges，但只在“有财务收益”范围内付；没收入，就没义务。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Apply life tenant charge duty limitation

reason.en: Identifies the wife as the life tenant whose duties are at issue.
reason.zh: 表明妻子为终身保有人，其义务是考点。

reason.en: Establishes the sister as remainderman who paid taxes and seeks reimbursement.
reason.zh: 确立妹妹为剩余权益人并主张税款返还。

reason.en: Signals the lots produced no financial benefit during the life tenancy.
reason.zh: 表明土地在终身保有期间未产生经济收益。

keywords.text: did not pay the real estate taxes

reason.en: Triggers whether the life tenant breached a duty to pay current charges.
reason.zh: 引发终身保有人是否负有缴纳当期税费义务的问题。

keywords.text: tax sale of the fee simple

reason.en: Explains why the sister paid taxes and now seeks recovery.
reason.zh: 说明妹妹为何代缴税款并提起返还之诉。

reason.en: Frames the sister's remedy as recoupment of taxes she advanced.
reason.zh: 将妹妹的请求定性为垫付税款的追偿。

A.text: never received any income from the lots

reason.en: Correctly limits the life tenant's tax duty to financial benefit received from the land.
reason.zh: 正确地将缴税义务限定于从土地获得的经济收益。

reason.en: Misstates that possession alone controls the tax-payment duty.
reason.zh: 错误地认为仅有占有即可决定是否缴税。

B.text: right to decide whether or not taxes should be paid

reason.en: Treats tax payment as optional based on possession rather than benefit received.
reason.zh: 将缴税视为基于占有的任意选择，而非基于收益。

C.text: life tenant has the duty to pay current charges

reason.en: States the general rule while ignoring the financial-benefit limitation.
reason.zh: 陈述一般规则却忽略经济收益限制。

reason.en: Assumes recovery and wrongly measures damages by lifetime interest value.
reason.zh: 在本无返还义务时仍以终身利息现值计算赔偿。

highlights.text: to his wife for life with remainder in fee simple to his sister

reason.en: Creates the life tenancy and remainder interests that define the parties' duties.
reason.zh: 创设终身产权与剩余权益，界定双方义务关系。

highlights.text: vacant and unproductive

reason.en: Shows the property generated no financial benefit to cap the life tenant's charge duty.
reason.zh: 表明土地未产生经济收益，从而限制终身保有人的费用义务。

highlights.text: The wife left the lots vacant and did not pay the real estate taxes due for Lots 1 and 2.

reason.en: Combines lack of use with nonpayment, supporting no duty because no benefit was received.
reason.zh: 结合闲置与未缴税，支持因无收益而不负缴税义务。

highlights.text: future real estate taxes on Lots 1 and 2 were her responsibility to pay

reason.en: May mislead examinees to assume a tax duty exists regardless of benefit received.
reason.zh: 可能误导考生认为不论是否获益都负有缴税义务。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
Six years ago, the owner of an estate in fee simple executed and delivered to his nephew an instrument in the proper form of a warranty deed, purporting to convey his estate to "my nephew and his heirs." At that time, the nephew was a widower who had one child, a daughter.
Three years ago, the nephew executed and delivered to his neighbor an instrument in the proper form of a warranty deed, purporting to convey the estate to "my neighbor." The nephew's daughter did not join in the deed. The neighbor was, and still is, unmarried and childless.
The only possibly applicable statute in the jurisdiction states that any deed will be construed to convey the grantor's entire estate, unless expressly limited.
Last month, the nephew died, never having remarried. His daughter is his only heir.
Who is the owner of the estate?

choices.A: The daughter and neighbor as joint tenants, because both survived the nephew.
choices.B: The daughter and neighbor as tenants in common of equal shares.
choices.C: The daughter, because the nephew's death ended the neighbor's life estate pur autre vie.
choices.D: The neighbor in fee simple pursuant to the nephew's deed.

questions.explanation:
Conveying fee simple absolute

Owner
“to my nephew and his heirs”
words of purchase
words of limitation
words of purchase + words of limitation = express fee simple absolute
Nephew
“to my neighbor”
words of purchase
words of purchase – words of limitation = presumed fee simple absolute
Neighbor

Ownership in real property is transferred from a grantor (current owner) to a grantee (new owner) through a conveying instrument like a will or deed. A conveying instrument usually contains both:

  • words of purchase – identifying the new owner (eg, “to my nephew”)
  • words of limitation – identifying the type of estate being conveyed (eg, “and his heirs”).

“And his/her heirs” are words of limitation traditionally used to transfer a fee simple absolute (FSA or fee simple) – the most common and broadest form of property ownership. However, these words of limitation are not required since an FSA is presumed by law when no such words are used. And since an FSA conveys title without any conditions, limitations, or accompanying future interests, no ownership interest is created in the grantee's heirs.

Here, the owner of an FSA conveyed his interest to his nephew by warranty deed. Since the deed used the words of limitation “and his heirs,” it conveyed an FSA to the nephew (but created no ownership interest in the daughter/heir). The nephew then conveyed his interest to his neighbor by a warranty deed that lacked words of limitation. Therefore, the neighbor received an FSA and owns the estate without any conditions or limitations.

(Choices A & B) Joint tenancy and tenancy in common are two types of concurrent estates. Concurrent estates are created only when a conveying instrument identifies two or more persons as grantees (not seen here).

(Choice C) A life estate pur autre vie is an ownership interest that lasts for the duration of the life of someone other than the grantee. It is transferred when a conveying instrument states “to A” (words of purchase) “for the life of B” (words of limitation). Since the nephew's warranty deed to the neighbor contained no such language, the neighbor did not receive a life estate pur autre vie.

📌 Educational Objective

A fee simple absolute is the broadest form of property ownership and is transferred when the conveying instrument's words of limitation state “and his/her heirs” OR when no words of limitation are used.

📚 References
  • Restatement (First) of Property § 14 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (types of fee simple estates).
  • Restatement (First) of Property § 15 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (estate in fee simple absolute).
  • Restatement (First) of Property § 39 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (presumption of fee simple absolute).
questions.zh-question:
六年前，一位完全保有地产权（fee simple）的所有人签署并向其侄子交付了一份格式合规的担保契据（warranty deed），意图将其地产转让给“我的侄子及其继承人”。当时，该侄子是鳏夫，有一个女儿。

三年前，该侄子签署并向其邻居交付了一份格式合规的担保契据，意图将该地产转让给“我的邻居”。侄子的女儿未在该契据上联署。该邻居当时至今均未婚且无子女。

该司法管辖区唯一可能适用的成文法规定，任何契据都将被解释为转让转让人的全部地产权，除非有明确限制。

上个月，侄子去世，未再婚。他的女儿是他唯一的继承人。

谁是该地产的所有人？

zh-choices.A: 女儿和邻居作为联权共有人（joint tenants），因为他们都在侄子去世后存活。
zh-choices.B: 女儿和邻居作为拥有同等份额的按份共有人（tenants in common）。
zh-choices.C: 女儿，因为侄子的死亡终止了邻居的他益终身地产权（life estate pur autre vie）。
zh-choices.D: 邻居，依据侄子的契据拥有完全保有地产权（fee simple）。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Present estates

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：转让契据里 “and his heirs” 和“没写限制语”都默认在传 fee simple absolute，不会自动给继承人留下产权。

三秒认题路径：

看契据用语 → 找限制语 → 默认FSA → 继承人不分产权 → 选邻居

核心法律规则

这题只要抓住的规则

words of purchase（受让人名称） 是“谁拿地”；words of limitation（限制语） 是“拿什么地产”。所以 “and his heirs” 是经典限制语，指向 fee simple absolute，但不是给“heirs”本人留份额。

更关键的是，题干给了成文法：只要没有明确限制，契据就按 grantor's entire estate 解释。换句话说，邻居那份契据虽没写 and his heirs，仍然默认为最宽的 fee simple absolute。

核心判例： 这里不靠特定判例发散，题眼就是传统 fee simple absolute 的解释规则：继承人不是受让人，没被单独写进契据就不会拿到产权。

思维导图

起点：看两份契据到底是在传什么地产？
第一份：“to my nephew and his heirs”
命中：有受让人 + 有限制语 → 传出 fee simple absolute
结果：heirs 只是限制语，不是女儿的产权来源。
第二份：“to my neighbor”
先看成文法：无明确限制时，默认解释成 grantor's entire estate
卡死点：不是 life estate pur autre vie，因为根本没写“for the life of B”
最终结论：邻居拿到 fee simple absolute，最后由邻居单独所有。
排错：子女不是共同受让人，不能凭“继承人身份”自动进份额。
答案落点：选 D：neighbor in fee simple

考点陷阱

你可能会想：弟弟先把地给了侄子，后来侄子死了，遗产当然该回到女儿手里。

但考试真正问的是：第二份 deed 有没有把邻居变成 life estate pur autre vie，还是直接给了 fee simple absolute。

司法考试看的是「契据有没有写出限制地产的语言」，而不是「侄女最后是不是法定继承人」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干第二份契据只有 to my neighbor，按默认规则仍传出 fee simple absolute，所以最后产权在邻居，不在女儿。

❌ 概念混淆 | 共同持有误判

✕ A: 把 joint tenants 硬塞进来，题干根本没写两个受让人。

❌ 事实误判 | 份额偷换

✕ B: 这不是两人按份共有，女儿并非契据受让人。

❌ 法律适用 | 人寿地产套错

✕ C: 把 life estate pur autre vie 套进来，但契据没写“按他人寿命”。

这题建议用什么方法？

先读契据里的用语，再判断是不是只剩默认的 fee simple absolute。

考场速记

记住：“and his heirs” 是老派限制语，不是给继承人发份额；没写限制时，很多州法也默认传 fee simple absolute。

一句话背法：看契据先找“谁是受让人”，再找“给多大地产”；没限制，通常就是最完整的所有权。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Classify estate from deed language

reason.en: Establishes the broadest estate type initially held by the grantor.
reason.zh: 表明出让人最初持有的是最完整的产权类型。

reason.en: Classic language conveying fee simple absolute to the nephew without vesting heirs.
reason.zh: 典型用语向侄子转移绝对永久产权，并不直接赋予继承人产权。

reason.en: Identifies the only named grantee in the second conveyance.
reason.zh: 指明第二次转让中唯一被点名的受让人。

keywords.text: did not join in the deed

reason.en: Shows the daughter was not a party to the neighbor's deed.
reason.zh: 表明女儿并非邻居契据的转让方或受让方。

keywords.text: any deed will be construed to convey the grantor's entire estate, unless expressly limited

reason.en: Presumes a fee simple transfer when the deed lacks express limitations.
reason.zh: 在契据未明确限定时，推定转让的是全部产权。

keywords.text: His daughter is his only heir

reason.en: Tempts test-takers to give the daughter an ownership interest after the nephew's death.
reason.zh: 易诱使考生认为侄子死后女儿应取得产权。

reason.en: Implies a concurrent estate not created by a single-grantee deed.
reason.zh: 暗示存在单一受让人契据无法设立的并发产权。

reason.en: Misapplies survivorship where no joint tenancy was ever created.
reason.zh: 在从未设立共同共有时错误套用生存者取得规则。

reason.en: Suggests shared ownership without two named grantees in one instrument.
reason.zh: 在一份契据未点名两名受让人时仍主张共有产权。

reason.en: Assumes the daughter retained a present undivided interest.
reason.zh: 假定女儿仍保留现时的未分割产权利益。

label.en: life estate measured by another's life
label.zh: 以他人生命为期间的生命产权

reason.en: Swaps in a lesser estate requiring explicit life-limitation language.
reason.zh: 偷换为需要明确生命限定用语才可设立的较小产权。

reason.en: Treats the neighbor's interest as ending when the measuring life died.
reason.zh: 将邻居的利益误当作随衡量生命死亡而终止。

reason.en: States the correct estate type presumed from the nephew's deed.
reason.zh: 指出侄子契据依推定所转移的正确产权类型。

label.zh: 源于第二次转让的产权

reason.en: Anchors ownership in the neighbor's deed rather than inheritance.
reason.zh: 将产权归属定位于邻居契据而非继承取得。

highlights.text: purporting to convey the estate to "my neighbor."

label.zh: 向唯一受让人的第二次契据

reason.en: The neighbor is the only grantee named and controls what estate was conveyed.
reason.zh: 邻居是唯一被点名的受让人，决定转让了何种产权。

highlights.text: any deed will be construed to convey the grantor's entire estate, unless expressly limited

reason.en: Without express limitation, the neighbor received the nephew's entire fee simple.
reason.zh: 未明确限定时，邻居取得侄子全部绝对永久产权。

highlights.text: The nephew's daughter did not join in the deed.

reason.en: Eliminates any claim that the daughter co-conveyed or retained title through the deed.
reason.zh: 排除女儿共同转让或通过契据保留产权的主张。

highlights.text: His daughter is his only heir.

reason.en: Distracts toward inheritance even though the neighbor already held fee simple.
reason.zh: 易引向继承分析，尽管邻居已持有绝对永久产权。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A woman died testate. In her will, she devised a farm she owned to her husband for life, remainder to her niece. Her will did not specify the duties of the husband and the niece with regard to maintenance and expenses related to the farm. The husband took sole possession of the farm, did not farm the land, and did not rent the land to a third person, although the fair rental value was substantial.
For two years in a row after the woman died, the county assessor sent the tax bills to the niece. However, the niece did not pay the bills, because she and the husband could not agree on who should pay them. Finally, the niece paid the taxes to avoid a tax foreclosure sale.
The niece then sued the husband for reimbursement for the two years' worth of property taxes.
There is no applicable statute.
Is the niece likely to prevail?

choices.A: No, because remaindermen are solely responsible for the payment of property taxes.
choices.B: No, because the county assessor sent the bills to the niece.
choices.C: No, because the woman's will was silent on responsibility for payment of property taxes.
choices.D: Yes, because the niece paid an obligation that was the sole responsibility of the husband.

questions.explanation:
Life tenant's duties
Duty to pay current charges Life tenant must pay all current charges due during life tenancy (eg, property taxes, mortgage interest) up to financial benefit received from property
Duty to prevent waste Life tenant must prevent affirmative waste (ie, voluntary waste), permissive waste & ameliorative waste
Duty to make ordinary repairs Life tenant must make reasonable repairs to preserve property

The holder of a life estate (ie, the life tenant) has a duty to pay current charges - eg, property taxes and mortgage interest - unless the document creating the life estate provides otherwise. This duty is limited to the amount of income that can be generated from the land. If the holder of the remainder (ie, the remainderman) pays the current property charges instead, then the remainderman is entitled to reimbursement from the life tenant.

Here, the woman's will granted the husband a life estate but was silent regarding the duty to pay current charges. Therefore, the husband (life tenant) had a duty to pay those charges - including the property taxes - up to the amount of income the farm could generate. Because the farm's fair rental value was substantial, the husband was obligated to pay all the property taxes. But since the niece (remainderman) ultimately paid those taxes, she is entitled to reimbursement from the husband.

(Choices A & C) Life tenants - not remaindermen - are solely responsible for all current charges unless the document creating the life estate provides otherwise. Here, the woman's will was silent on the matter, so the property taxes were the husband's sole responsibility.

(Choice B) The fact that the county assessor sent the tax bills to the niece has no effect on the husband's obligation to pay or reimburse the property taxes.

📌 Educational Objective

Unless the document creating the life estate provides otherwise, a life tenant has the duty to pay all current charges (eg, property taxes, mortgage interest) up to the amount of income that can be generated from the land.

📚 References
  • Restatement (First) of Property §§ 129 - 130 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (life tenant's duty to pay current charges).
questions.zh-question:
一名女性立有遗嘱去世。在遗嘱中，她将自己拥有的一个农场遗赠给她的丈夫终身保有，剩余权益归于她的侄女。她的遗嘱没有具体说明丈夫和侄女在农场维护和费用方面的责任。丈夫取得了农场的独占权，但他没有耕种土地，也没有将土地出租给第三方，尽管其公允租金价值相当可观。

在该女性去世后的连续两年里，县税务评估员将税单寄给了侄女。然而，侄女没有支付这些账单，因为她和丈夫无法就谁应该支付达成一致。最终，为了避免税务止赎拍卖，侄女支付了税款。

随后，侄女起诉丈夫，要求其偿还这两年的房产税。

本案无适用的成文法。

侄女有可能胜诉吗？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为剩余权益人对支付房产税负有全部责任。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为县税务评估员将账单寄给了侄女。
zh-choices.C: 不会，因为该女性的遗嘱对支付房产税的责任未作规定。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为侄女支付了一项本应由丈夫承担全部责任的债务。

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Duties of Tenant

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：终身承租人（life tenant）默认要负担当前费用，尤其是财产税（property taxes）；受遗赠的剩余权益人先垫付后，可以向他追偿。

三秒认题路径：

终身地产 → 当前费用 → 遗嘱沉默 → 先垫税款 → 可追偿

核心法律规则

只要设立终身地产（life estate）的文件没有另作约定，终身承租人（life tenant）就要支付占有期间产生的当前费用（current charges），考场意思：包括财产税和抵押利息。这个义务上限是该土地能产生的收益，所以本题只看农场能带来多少收入。若剩余权益人（remainderman）先替他垫付，事后就能向终身承租人要回。

核心判例： Restatement (First) of Property §§ 129–130 — 这里锁定的就是：默认由终身承租人支付当前费用，除非设立文件改规则。

思维导图

遗嘱设立
终身地产
→
丈夫
life tenant
→
农场税单
current charges
→
妮子先垫付
remainderman
遗嘱有没有把当前费用改给别人？
没有 → 默认还是丈夫付财产税
丈夫没耕种 → 不影响当前费用义务
税单寄给妮子 ≠ 责任转给妮子
妮子先付款 → 可向丈夫请求 reimbursement
结论：丈夫输，妮子可追偿

考点陷阱

你可能会想：税单寄给妮子，而且她是剩余权益人，所以应该轮到她负责。

但考试真正问的是：谁对当前费用（current charges）负默认义务；这里是终身承租人（life tenant），不是剩余权益人。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干显示遗嘱没改规则，而丈夫作为life tenant应负担财产税；妮子先垫付后，就能向他要回。

❌ 概念混淆 | 责任倒置误判

✕ A: 把remaindermen当成默认纳税人了。

❌ 事实误判 | 税单送达误判

✕ B: 税单寄到谁手里，不会改掉真正的付款义务。

❌ 法律适用 | 遗嘱沉默误判

✕ C: 遗嘱没写分配方式，反而默认回到丈夫身上。

这题建议用什么方法？

先找默认规则，再看遗嘱有没有改写；只要没改，终身承租人就先付当前费用。

考场速记

记住一句：终身承租人付当前费用，剩余权益人先垫可追偿。这题不用被税单寄送对象带跑，先看谁是默认责任人。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
Thirty years ago, a landowner conveyed land by warranty deed to a church (a charity) "so long as the land herein conveyed is used as the site for the principal religious edifice maintained by said church."
Twenty years ago, the landowner died intestate, survived by a single heir.
One year ago, the church dissolved and its church building situated on the land was demolished.
There is no applicable statute. The common law Rule Against Perpetuities is unmodified in the jurisdiction.
In an appropriate action, the landowner's heir and the attorney general, who is the appropriate official to assert public interests in charitable trusts, contest the right to the land.
In this action, who will prevail?

choices.A: The attorney general, because cy pres should be applied to devote the land to religious purposes to carry out the charitable intent of the landowner.
choices.B: The attorney general, because the landowner's attempt to restrict the church's fee simple violated the common law Rule Against Perpetuities.
choices.C: The landowner's heir, as successor to the landowner's possibility of reverter.
choices.D: The landowner's heir, because a charity cannot convey assets donated to it.

questions.explanation:
Fee simple estates
Type Language Future interest
Indefeasible Fee simple absolute
  • “To A”
  • “To A and his heirs”
 None
Defeasible Fee simple determinable
  • Durational
    • “so long as”
    • “during”
    • “until”
Grantor’s possibility of reverter
Third party’s executory interest (ie, fee simple subject to executory limitation)
Defeasible Fee simple subject to condition subsequent
  • Conditional
    • “but if”
    • “provided that”
    • “unless”
 Grantor’s right of entry

Defeasible fees are fee simple estates that automatically terminate if a specified event or condition occurs. One type of defeasible fee is a fee simple determinable (FSD), which is created with durational language (eg, “so long as”). An FSD is followed by either:

  • a possibility of reverter – when the estate automatically reverts back to the grantor upon the happening of the specified event (presumed if not expressly stated) or
  • an executory interest – when the estate automatically passes to a third party upon the happening of the specified event (must be expressly stated).

Here, the landowner conveyed the church an FSD followed by the landowner’s possibility of reverter. When the landowner died, his possibility of reverter was inherited by his sole heir. So when the church dissolved and its principal religious edifice (ie, the church building) was demolished, title automatically reverted to the landowner’s heir. Therefore, the heir will prevail.

(Choice A) When a charitable trust no longer serves the purpose for which it was created, courts can use the cy pres doctrine to redirect the trust to a similar charity or purpose. However, this doctrine does not apply when the conveyance includes a possibility of reverter (as seen here) or otherwise dictates what should happen when the assets for the trust are no longer used.

(Choice B) Under the Rule Against Perpetuities, specific future interests are void if there is any possibility that the interest will not vest within 21 years after the end of all lives in being at the creation of the interest. But this rule does not apply to future interests held by the grantor (eg, a possibility of reverter) OR charitable trusts.

(Choice D) A charity can convey assets donated to it.

📌 Educational Objective

A fee simple determinable is a defeasible fee created with durational language. Unless otherwise stated, it is presumed that the estate will automatically revert back to the grantor if the terminating event or condition occurs.

📚 References
  • Restatement of Property § 44 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (fee simple determinable).
questions.zh-question:
三十年前，一位土地所有者通过附有担保的契约将土地转让给一个教堂（一个慈善机构），契约规定“只要此转让的土地被用作所述教堂维持其主要宗教建筑的所在地”。

二十年前，该土地所有者未立遗嘱而去世，仅有一位继承人尚存。

一年前，该教堂解散，其位于该土地上的教堂建筑被拆除。

本案没有适用的成文法。在该司法管辖区内，普通法中的反永久所有权规则(Rule Against Perpetuities)未作修改。

在一项适当的诉讼中，土地所有者的继承人与司法部长（他是维护慈善信托公共利益的适当官员）就土地的权利展开争讼。

在这场诉讼中，谁将胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 司法部长，因为应适用近似适用原则(cy pres)，将土地用于宗教目的，以实现土地所有者的慈善意图。
zh-choices.B: 司法部长，因为土地所有者试图限制教堂的完全保有地产权(fee simple)的行为，违反了普通法中的反永久所有权规则(Rule Against Perpetuities)。
zh-choices.C: 土地所有者的继承人，作为土地所有者的复归可能性(possibility of reverter)的继承人。
zh-choices.D: 土地所有者的继承人，因为慈善机构不能转让捐赠给它的资产。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Present estates

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：fee simple determinable（可解除费简单地产）一旦触发限定条件，土地会自动回到设定人一方，而不是由法院用 cy pres（近似适用） 改写成别的用途。

三秒认题路径：

“so long as” → FSD → 自动终止 → possibility of reverter → 继承人赢

核心法律规则

带有持续性用语的转让，比如 “so long as（只要）”，通常是在设定 fee simple determinable（可解除费简单地产）。考场意思：一旦指定用途不再存在，地产自动回到设定人或其继受人，不需要再额外发通知。

possibility of reverter（回归可能性）是设定人保留的未来利益；设定人死亡后，这个利益通常随遗产走给继承人。考场意思：这里教堂一旦不再作主礼拜建筑，土地就自动回转给土地人的继承人。

Rule Against Perpetuities（永续限制规则）不打到设定人保留的未来利益，也不把这类自动回转问题改成慈善信托的 cy pres。所以本题不是“怎么继续做慈善”，而是“土地最后归谁”。

核心判例： Restatement of Property § 44 这类 fee simple determinable 触发后，土地默认自动回到设定人一方。

思维导图

看到 “so long as”
先判定：这是 fee simple determinable，不是绝对所有权。
触发点：教堂不再用作主礼拜建筑，限定条件已经失效。
法律后果：土地 automatically 回到设定人一方的未来利益。
卡死点：这题不是改造慈善用途，而是先看设定人的 possibility of reverter。
再排除：cy pres 不救这种带回归条款的转让。
结论：设定人死后，回归可能性给了唯一继承人，所以继承人赢。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然教会是慈善组织，法院就应该用 cy pres 把土地继续留给宗教用途。

但考试真正问的是：这份契约已经写了“so long as”这种限定语言，先看是否触发 fee simple determinable，不是先改写成别的慈善目标。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这里一旦用途消失，权利会按原始设定自动回转，cy pres 不能把这个结果改掉。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干的 “so long as” 是典型 fee simple determinable，用途终止后土地自动回到设定人一方；设定人死亡后，这个 possibility of reverter 由继承人承接，所以继承人胜。

❌ 概念混淆 | 慈善改用误判

✕ A: 把 cy pres 当成万能改写器，忽略了这份转让早就写死回归路径。

❌ 法律适用 | RAP套错场景

✕ B: 把 Rule Against Perpetuities 硬套给设定人保留利益，方向错了。

❌ 事实误判 | 处分能力偷换

✕ D: 说慈善团体不能转让赠与财产，题干根本没在考这个限制。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓限定用语，再判未来利益归属，最后把慈善改用、RAP 和处分能力逐个排开。

考场速记

记住一句：“so long as / during / until” 通常先想到 fee simple determinable，再想到 possibility of reverter 会自动回到设定人或继承人。

顺口溜：先看“durational language”，再看“automatic reverter”，最后问自己：谁拿得到最后那块地？

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man owned a tract of land in fee simple. By warranty deed he conveyed the land to his brother for life "and from and after the death of my brother to my sister, her heirs and assigns."
Subsequently the sister died, devising all of her estate to a friend. The sister was survived by a daughter, her sole heir-at-law.
Shortly thereafter the brother died, survived by the man, the friend, and the daughter.
Title to the land now is in whom?

choices.A: Either the man or the daughter, depending upon whether the destructibility of contingent remainders is recognized in the applicable jurisdiction.
choices.B: The daughter, because she is the sister's heir.
choices.C: The friend, because the vested remainder in the sister was transmitted by her will.
choices.D: The man, because the contingent remainder never vested and the man's reversion was entitled to possession immediately upon the brother's death.

questions.explanation:
Man →
Life estate
“To my brother for life”
→
Vested remainder
“then to my sister, her heirs & assigns”
↓
Sister →
Devise
“devising all of her estate to a friend”

A life estate终身地产权：以某人的生命期为存续期间的现时占有性地产权益。 is a present possessory estate that terminates upon the death of an individual. This estate is followed by either a reversion (if retained by the grantor) or a remainder (if created in a grantee). Remainders are fully transferable inter vivos, devisable by will, and descendible by inheritance. This is true in most jurisdictions† regardless of whether the remainder is:

  • vested – not subject to any conditions precedent AND held by an identifiable living person (eg, “then to my sister, her heirs and assigns”) or
  • contingent – is subject to an express condition precedent (other than the natural termination of the prior estate) OR held by an unknown or unborn person (eg, “then to my neighbor, but only if…”).

Here, the man conveyed his fee simple estate to his brother for life, which then passed to his sister unconditionally when the brother died. The sister’s vested remainder was devisable, so it passed to the friend after the sister died – leaving no interest in the property for the daughter to inherit (Choice B). Therefore, title to the land is now in the friend.

†At common law and in a minority of jurisdictions, contingent remainders cannot be transferred inter vivos.

(Choice A) The doctrine of destructibility of contingent remainders provides that a remainder will be destroyed if it has not vested at the time the preceding interest ends. Here, the sister’s remainder was vested, so this doctrine does not apply.

(Choice D) Had the sister received a contingent remainder that had not vested by the time the preceding estate (brother’s life estate) had terminated, the grantor’s (man’s) reversion would have become immediately possessory upon the brother’s death.

📌 Educational Objective

Remainders are either vested (ie, not subject to conditions precedent and held by an identifiable living person) OR contingent (ie, subject to conditions precedent or held by an unknown or unborn person). Both are transferrable, devisable, and descendible.

📚 References
  • Restatement of Property §§ 162, 164–65 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (transferability of remainders).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子以完全所有权(fee simple)拥有一块土地。他通过一份担保契约(warranty deed)将该土地转让给其兄弟终身持有，“并于我兄弟去世后，将土地给予我的妹妹，及其继承人和受让人。”

随后，妹妹去世，通过遗嘱将其全部财产赠予一位朋友。妹妹去世时，其在世的亲人有一名女儿，该女儿是其唯一的法定继承人。

此后不久，兄弟去世，其在世的亲人有该男子、朋友和女儿。

现在该土地的所有权归属于谁？

zh-choices.A: 该男子或女儿，取决于适用司法管辖区是否承认或有剩余权的可废除性(destructibility of contingent remainders)。
zh-choices.B: 女儿，因为她是妹妹的继承人。
zh-choices.C: 朋友，因为妹妹的既定剩余权(vested remainder)已通过其遗嘱转移。
zh-choices.D: 该男子，因为或有剩余权(contingent remainder)从未既定，并且在该兄弟去世后，该男子的复归权(reversion)立即有权占有。

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Present estates

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：终身地产权（life estate）后面的既得余留（vested remainder）能不能被遗嘱转走；答案是能，所以最后看谁拿到这个既得余留。

三秒认题路径：

终身地产权 → 余留权益 → 是否既得 → 能否遗嘱处分 → 友人得权

核心法律规则

余留（remainder）是接在前一个现时地产后面的未来权益，考场意思：前面的人的使用期结束后，后面的人接着拿产权。

既得余留（vested remainder）是已经归到一个“已存在、可识别的人”手里的余留，考场意思：这个权利现在就属于他，所以他可以在生前转让，也可以用遗嘱处分。

附带余留（contingent remainder）才会卡在条件没满足或受益人未确定，考场意思：没站稳的未来权益才会让你怀疑能不能转。

核心判例：本题不靠特殊新法，直接按一般财产法规则：妹妹拿到的是既得余留，所以她去世前就能把这项权利通过遗嘱给朋友。

思维导图

男子 原始所有人，先前持有 fee simple
→
兄弟 拿到 life estate
→
姐妹 拿到 vested remainder
→
朋友 姐妹用遗嘱处分后受让人
关键事实：文书写的是 “then to my sister, her heirs and assigns”
法律关卡：这不是要等条件成就的附带余留
卡死结论：既得余留可被遗嘱转移，不会回到赠与人
答案：现在产权在朋友手里

考点陷阱

你可能会想：姐姐死了，权利就该给她的继承人或回到原始出让人那里。

但考试真正问的是：她拿到的是既得余留（vested remainder），不是悬而未决的未来权利。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

所以“姐姐先死”不等于“权利消失”；只要余留已经既得，她生前就能用遗嘱把它转给朋友。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干写明姐妹拿到的是 then to my sister, her heirs and assigns，这说明她拿到的是既得余留；既得余留可遗嘱处分，所以朋友取得产权。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把 destructibility 当成关键点，但这里根本不是未既得的余留。

❌ 事实误判 | 继承对象偷换

✕ B: 以为姐姐死后自然落给她的继承人，忽略了她已经用遗嘱处分过。

❌ 法律适用 | 回归赠与人误判

✕ D: 把contingent remainder套进来，但题目给的是既得余留，不会回到男人。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看未来权益是既得还是附带，再决定能不能遗嘱处分；别先被“谁后来死了”带跑。

考场速记

记忆口诀：既得余留先看“人已确定、条件已过”，只要站稳了，就能 devise、transfer、descend。

本题一眼记：life estate 后接 vested remainder，余留人死前怎么处分，答案就怎么走。

reason.zh: 将或然剩余权规则错误适用于既得剩余权。

reason.zh: 将姐姐的既得剩余权误作或然剩余权，从而主张出让人取回权。

reason.zh: 错误假设出让人保留取回权，而非向姐姐创设剩余权。

highlights.text: from and after the death of my brother to my sister, her heirs and assigns

reason.en: This grant creates a vested remainder in the sister, not a reversion in the man.
reason.zh: 该授予语言向姐姐创设既得剩余权，而非保留给出让人取回权。

reason.en: Because the vested remainder was devisable, the friend took the sister's interest before the brother died.
reason.zh: 既得剩余权可遗嘱处分，故在兄弟死亡前该权益已移转给朋友。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
An individual entered into an oral agreement with the owner of a residence to rent the residence for one year. They agreed that the individual was to pay a total of $12,000 in rent, payable in monthly installments of $1,000. The individual occupied the residence for one year but failed to pay the final $1,000 installment. At the end of the one-year period, the individual moved out of the residence without giving the owner any notice of his intent to do so.
Has the individual's tenancy been terminated?

choices.A: No, because the individual failed to give the owner notice of his intent to vacate the residence.
choices.B: No, because the individual failed to make the final $1,000 installment payment.
choices.C: Yes, because the agreement was oral.
choices.D: Yes, because the individual vacated the premises.

questions.explanation:
Types of tenancies
Type Creation Duration Termination
Term of years Agreement (ie, lease) Fixed period (eg, one month, three years) End of term (automatic)
Breach of certain covenants (eg, rent, habitability)
Periodic tenancy Agreement
Presumed when lease has no specified termination date
Operation of law (eg, holdover tenant)		 Periodically renews until terminated End of period (proper notice)
Breach of certain covenants
Tenancy at will Agreement
Implied when person allowed to possess premises without paying rent		 Indefinite period At any time (reasonable notice)
Tenancy at sufferance Implied when tenant keeps possession after lease expires (ie, holdover tenancy) Continues until terminated Landlord evicts
Tenant vacates
Landlord accepts rent (forms periodic tenancy)

A tenancy for years is an estate measured by a fixed and ascertainable amount of time. This type of tenancy is created by an agreement between the landlord and the tenant and may be for any length of time (eg, one week, six months, five years). Termination occurs automatically upon the expiration of the term, with no notice required from either party. As a result, a tenant who remains on the premises after the term expires becomes a tenant at sufferance (ie, holdover tenant).

Here, the individual and the owner entered into a lease that created a tenancy for years with a one-year term. This tenancy terminated automatically at the end of the one-year term (Choice A). And since the individual vacated the premises, no tenancy at sufferance was created. Therefore, the individual's tenancy has been terminated.

(Choice B) The individual's failure to make the final $1,000 installment payment is not a reason for the tenancy to continue. Instead, it was a breach of the lease agreement that gave the owner the right to take legal action to terminate the tenancy early. But the owner did not do so, and the tenancy terminated automatically at the end of the one-year period. However, the owner can still sue the individual to recover the unpaid rent.

(Choice C) The statute of frauds applies to a tenancy for years that is longer than one year (not seen here) and requires the lease agreement to be in writing防止欺诈法（Statute of Frauds）要求超过一年的租约必须以书面形式订立。. However, a lease subject to the statute of frauds that does not comply with it may be enforceable as a periodic tenancy when, as here, the tenant occupies the premises with the landlord's permission and the landlord accepts rent from the tenant.†

†If the tenant also makes substantial improvements to the premises and thereby indicates that the parties contemplated a lease for more than a year, then the noncomplying lease is given full effect.

📌 Educational Objective

A tenancy for years (ie, an estate for a fixed and ascertainable term) terminates automatically upon the expiration of the term without notice from either party.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant § 1.4 cmt. e (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (termination of tenancy for years).

该个人的租赁关系是否已经终止？

zh-choices.B: 否，因为该个人未能支付最后一期1,000美元的租金。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为该协议是口头的。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为该个人搬离了该房产。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Types of tenancies

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：定期租赁（tenancy for years）到期后会不会自动结束，以及承租人搬走后会不会变成剩余占有（tenancy at sufferance）。

三秒认题路径：

一整年租期 → 到期节点 → 自动终止 → 搬走离场 → 不成剩余占有

核心法律规则

把规则说成人话

定期租赁（tenancy for years）是有固定、可确定期限的租约，考场意思：时间一到就自动结束，不需要房东或租客再发通知。

如果租客在期限届满后还继续占房，才会变成剩余占有（tenancy at sufferance）；但如果租客已经搬走，就没有这个后续状态。

欠最后一期租金只是违约，考场意思：房东可以去追钱或主张违约，但这不让租期继续拖着不结束。

核心判例： 本题按 Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord & Tenant § 1.4 cmt. e 的逻辑走：定期租赁到期即自动终止，是否通知不是终止条件。

思维导图

起点
口头约定 一年租期
固定期限已确定
期限中
每月付租
最后一期没付完
到期日
term of years 到期 → 自动终止
不用等通知
若还赖着不走
才会进 tenancy at sufferance
本题结论
人已搬走 → 没有剩余占有 → 租赁已终止

考点陷阱

你可能会想：没通知、没交完钱，是不是租约就还活着。

但考试真正问的是：这是不是定期租赁（tenancy for years）到期后的自动终止问题；答案看的是期限到了没有，不看你心里觉得房东“还没收到通知”。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干明确是一年固定租期，期限一到就自动结束；租客后来已经搬走，所以没有新的剩余占有（tenancy at sufferance）留下来。

❌ 事实误判 | 通知缺失误读

✕ A: 把 no notice 当成延期条件，但定期租赁到期本来就不靠通知续命。

❌ 法律适用 | 欠租拖期误判

✕ B: 把 final payment 当成租约是否结束的开关，其实它只引出违约追偿。

❌ 概念混淆 | 口头书面混淆

✕ C: 盯着 oral 就以为必然无效，但这里考的是到期终止，不是书面形式瑕疵。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓租期类型，再看是否到期自动终止，最后才问有没有留下holdover状态。

考场速记

记住一句：定期租赁（tenancy for years）看的是“期限到就散”，不是“有没有通知才散”；租客一搬走，通常就直接结束。

reason.en: A tenancy for years ends automatically when the stated term expires.

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A woman owned land in fee simple absolute. The woman conveyed the land to a friend "for life," and when the friend died the land was to go to the woman's neighbor "and her heirs."
The neighbor died and in her duly probated will devised her entire estate to a local charity. If she had died intestate, her daughter would have been her only heir.
One year after the neighbor died, her daughter executed a quitclaim deed conveying any interest she might have in the land to the woman's friend.
The common law Rule Against Perpetuities is unmodified in the jurisdiction. There are no other applicable statutes.
Who has what interest in the land?

choices.A: The friend has a fee simple absolute, because his life estate merged with the remainder conveyed to him by the daughter.
choices.B: The friend has a life estate and the charity has a vested remainder, because the neighbor's interest was devisable.
choices.C: The friend has a life estate and the daughter has a vested remainder, because the deed from the woman created an interest in the neighbor's heirs.
choices.D: The friend has a life estate and the woman has a reversion, because the neighbor's remainder was void under the Rule Against Perpetuities.

questions.explanation:
grantor ↓
life tenant ↓
remainderman ↓

The woman conveyed the land to a friend for life, then to her neighbor and her heirs.

Life estate
(present estate)
Vested remainder
(future interest)

A life estate is a present possessory interest in real property that terminates upon the death of an individual. The future-interest holder acquires possession of the estate when that death occurs. If the future interest is held by someone other than the grantor, it is called a remainder. Remainders are fully transferable inter vivos, devisable by will, and descendible by inheritance. This is true in most jurisdictions* regardless of whether the remainder is:

  • vested – not subject to any condition precedent AND held by an identifiable living person (eg, “then to my neighbor and her heirs”) or
  • contingent – subject to some condition precedent (other than the natural termination of the prior estate) OR held by an unknown or unborn person (eg, “then to my neighbor, but only if…”).

Here, the woman conveyed a life estate in the land to her friend, which would go to her neighbor unconditionally when the friend died. The neighbor’s vested remainder was devisable, so it passed to the charity under the terms of her duly probated will. Therefore, the friend (who is still living) has a life estate, and the charity has a vested remainder that will become possessory when the friend dies.

*At common law and in a minority of jurisdictions, contingent remainders cannot be transferred inter vivos.

(Choices A & C) The woman’s deed conveyed a remainder interest to the neighbor “and her heirs.” These words of limitation indicate that the neighbor’s remainder interest is a fee simple absolute (FSA). But they do not create an ownership interest in the neighbor’s heirs. Therefore, the daughter (neighbor’s only heir) did not have any interest in the land to convey to the friend, and he never acquired an FSA.

(Choice D) The Rule Against Perpetuities applies only to future interests that may vest more than 21 years after the death of some relevant person alive when the interest was created—not to this vested remainder.

📌 Educational Objective

Remainders are either vested (ie, not subject to conditions precedent and held by an identifiable living person) OR contingent (ie, subject to conditions precedent or held by an unknown or unborn person). Both are transferrable, devisable, and descendible.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Wills & Other Donative Transfers § 25.2 cmt. f (Am. Law Inst. 2011) (alienability, divisability, and inheritability of future interests).
questions.zh-question:
一名女子以完全简单所有权(fee simple absolute)拥有土地。该女子将土地转让给一个朋友，期限为“终身”，当该朋友去世后，土地将归该女子的邻居“及其继承人”所有。

邻居去世了，在她经过适当遗嘱认证的遗嘱中，她将全部遗产赠与了一家当地慈善机构。如果她无遗嘱去世，她的女儿将是她唯一的继承人。

邻居去世一年后，她的女儿签署了一份产权放弃契据(quitclaim deed)，将她可能在该土地上拥有的任何权益转让给了该女子的朋友。

该司法管辖区的普通法“反永久所有权规则”(Rule Against Perpetuities)未经修改。没有其他适用的法规。

谁对该土地拥有何种权益？

zh-choices.A: 该朋友拥有完全简单所有权，因为他的终身地产权与女儿转让给他的剩余地产权合并了。
zh-choices.B: 该朋友拥有终身地产权，慈善机构拥有既定剩余地产权，因为邻居的权益是可以通过遗嘱处分的。
zh-choices.C: 该朋友拥有终身地产权，女儿拥有既定剩余地产权，因为女子的契约在邻居的继承人中创造了权益。
zh-choices.D: 该朋友拥有终身地产权，该女子拥有复归权，因为邻居的剩余地产权根据“反永久所有权规则”是无效的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Future interests

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：看见 终身地产（life estate） 后面的未来利益，先判断它是 既得余留（vested remainder） 还是无效，再看它能不能通过遗嘱传给别人。

三秒认题路径：

终身地产 → 余留利益 → 已既得 → 可遗赠 → 选 B

核心法律规则

余留（remainder） 是在前一地产自然结束后，由非出让人取得占有的未来利益；如果它已经给了一个可识别的在世人，而且没有附加先决条件，就是 既得余留（vested remainder）。

既得余留 的考试意思很简单：devisable、descendible、transferable，所以持有人死后能按遗嘱走，不会因为她本人先死就消失。

Rule Against Perpetuities 只打击可能太晚才归属的未来利益；本题这个余留已经既得，所以不被它卡死。

核心判例： 这题不靠新判例翻盘，关键是传统余留规则：已既得的余留可以遗赠，邻居一死就进入其遗嘱处分链条。

思维导图

先看：邻居拿到的是什么？
事实 1 女人先给朋友 终身地产（life estate）。
事实 2 后面写的是“给邻居和她的继承人”。
规则 邻居是明确在世人，没有先决条件，所以是 既得余留（vested remainder）。
卡死点：既得余留可遗赠，邻居一死就随遗嘱给慈善机构。
再排除误区：RAP 会不会把它打掉？
答案 不会，因为它不是“可能很晚才归属”的可疑未来利益。
结论 朋友仍是终身地产，慈善机构拿到既得余留。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：邻居死了，女儿作为唯一继承人是不是还能把地转给朋友。

但考试真正问的是：邻居生前已经有 既得余留（vested remainder），她在遗嘱里怎么处分，才决定最后谁接手。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干的关键是邻居先拿到 vested remainder，而且她已立有效遗嘱把整个遗产留给慈善机构，所以最后是朋友持有终身地产、慈善机构持有余留。

❌ 概念混淆 | 继承回收误判

✕ A: 把女儿的 quitclaim 当成能“补回”邻居那份余留了。

❌ 法律适用 | heirs 归属误判

✕ C: 误把 and her heirs 当成给女儿的独立权利。

❌ 事实误判 | RAP 期限误判

✕ D: 想拿 Rule Against Perpetuities 砍掉已既得余留。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓前一地产和余留种类，再问能不能遗赠，最后才看 RAP 有没有真正出场。

考场速记

记住一句：既得余留（vested remainder） 先天可转、可遗赠、可继承；看到 “给某人和她的继承人” 时，先问是不是只是 words of limitation，别误以为给了继承人新权利。

这题的速记就是：先判余留是否既得，再看它怎么传；只要已经既得，持有人死后仍能按遗嘱走。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A landowner died, validly devising his land to his wife "for life or until remarriage, then to" their daughter. Shortly after the landowner's death, his daughter executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey the land to her friend. A year later, the daughter died intestate, with her mother, the original landowner's wife, as her sole heir. The following month, the wife remarried. The wife then executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey the land to her new husband as a wedding gift.
Who now owns what interest in the land?

choices.A: The daughter's friend owns the fee simple.
choices.B: The wife owns the fee simple.
choices.C: The wife's new husband has a life estate in the land for the wife's life, with the remainder in the daughter's friend.
choices.D: The wife's new husband owns the fee simple.

questions.explanation:
grantor ↓
life tenant ↓
stated event ↓
remainderman ↓

The landowner devised his land ‘to his wife for life or until remarriage, then to their daughter’

Defeasible life estate
(present interest)
Remainder
(future interest)

A defeasible life estate is a present interest that terminates upon the death of an individual OR the happening of a stated event. The future- interest holder (ie, remainderman) acquires possession of the estate when the death or event occurs. Future interests are alienable – ie, the remainderman can freely convey that interest.

Here, the landowner devised a defeasible life estate in the land to his wife, which would pass to their daughter upon the wife’s death or remarriage. Therefore, the daughter had a future interest that she properly conveyed to a friend, making the friend the new remainderman. When the wife remarried (and terminated her life estate), the land automatically transferred to the remainderman – the friend – in fee simple.

(Choices B & D) The wife had a defeasible life estate – not a fee simple – that ended when she remarried. As a result, the wife could only acquire a fee simple (or convey it to her new husband) if she inherited the daughter’s future interest. Since the daughter did not hold the future interest when she died (she had already conveyed it to her friend), that interest never passed to the wife. Therefore, neither the wife nor the new husband owns the fee simple.

(Choice C) Since the wife’s life estate terminated as soon as she remarried, she did not have a property interest to deed to the new husband. As a result, the new husband does not have an interest in the land.

📌 Educational Objective

A future interest that follows a defeasible life estate becomes possessory upon the death of an individual or the happening of a stated event. Future interests are alienable, meaning that the future-interest holder (ie, remainderman) can freely convey his/her interest.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Wills & Other Donative Transfers § 24.5 (Am. Law Inst. 2011) (life estates).
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Wills & Other Donative Transfers § 25.2 (Am. Law Inst. 2011) (reversions and remainders).

一位土地所有人去世，通过有效遗嘱将其土地遗赠给其妻子，“终身持有或直至再婚，然后归于”他们的女儿。土地所有人去世后不久，其女儿签署了一份符合法定格式的地契文书，意图将该土地转让给她的朋友。一年后，女儿无遗嘱死亡，其母亲，即原土地所有人的妻子，是其唯一继承人。次月，该妻子再婚。随后，妻子签署了一份符合法定格式的地契文书，意图将该土地作为结婚礼物转让给她的新任丈夫。

现在谁对该土地拥有何种权益？

zh-choices.A: 女儿的朋友拥有该土地的 fee simple。
zh-choices.B: 妻子拥有该土地的 fee simple。
zh-choices.C: 妻子的新任丈夫拥有以妻子生命为期的终身地产权(life estate)，剩余权益归女儿的朋友所有。
zh-choices.D: 妻子的新任丈夫拥有该土地的 fee simple。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Ownership of Real Property - Future interests

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：可撤销终身地产（defeasible life estate）结束后，余留权益（remainder）能不能先被女儿转给朋友，最后让朋友拿到完整所有权。

三秒认题路径：

先看遗嘱限制 → 再看女儿权利 → 再看能否转让 → 再看夫人再婚 → 最后定所有权

核心法律规则

遗嘱把土地给妻子“终身持有（for life）或直到再婚”，这给的是可撤销终身地产（defeasible life estate），不是 fee simple，所以妻子自己不能把已经终止的地权再送给新丈夫。

在这种结构里，女儿拿到的是未来利益（future interest），也就是余留权益（remainder）；考试上这类 future interest alienable，意思是可以先转让，所以女儿一旦把它 deed 给朋友，朋友就接手成了新的余留权益人。

等妻子后来再婚，触发终止条件，朋友的 future interest 立刻变成占有性完全所有权（fee simple）。这题的答案不是“谁是原来那个人的继承人”，而是“谁在终止时还握着余留权益”。

核心判例： 本题适用的就是 future interest 可自由转让的普通规则；考试要点是终止条件一到，余留权益人直接取得 fee simple。

思维导图

先问：妻子拿的是不是终身地产？
是“for life or until remarriage” = 可撤销终身地产（defeasible life estate）
接着看女儿拿到的是 余留权益（remainder），不是现在占有权
规则点future interest 可转让 → 女儿先 deed 给朋友
卡死点：朋友成了新的余留权益人，女儿死不影响这份已转出的权益。
最后看妻子再婚 → 终身地产自动终止 → 朋友立刻拿到 fee simple
答案选 A：daugher’s friend owns the fee simple

考点陷阱

你可能会想：女儿死后，她的份额就该回到妈妈名下，妈妈再婚时就能把整块地送给新丈夫。

但考试真正问的是：女儿死的时候，她手里那份 future interest 早就 deed 给朋友了，妈妈继承不到那份权益，所以新丈夫也拿不到 fee simple。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干里女儿先把 future interest deed 给朋友；等妻子再婚终止终身地产时，朋友直接取得 fee simple。

❌ 概念混淆 | 继承回流误判

✕ B: 把女儿已转出的权益又算回妈妈名下了。

❌ 法律适用 | 终身权利误套

✕ C: 把妻子再婚后已消失的权益还拿去 new husband 身上。

❌ 事实误判 | fee simple 偷换

✕ D: 直接把妻子的终身地产偷换成 fee simple。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清现在占有权和未来利益，再盯住“谁在终止时还持有权益”。

考场速记

记住一句话：未来利益（future interest）通常可以转让，终止条件一到，就直接落到最后的权益持有人手里。

这类题只抓两步：先认出可撤销终身地产（defeasible life estate），再问未来权益有没有先被卖掉。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A landlord and a tenant orally agreed to a commercial tenancy for a term of six months beginning on July 1. Rent was to be paid by the first day of each month, and the tenant paid the first month's rent at the time of the agreement.
When the tenant arrived at the leased premises on July 1, he learned that the previous tenant had not vacated the premises at the end of her lease term on May 31 and did not intend to vacate. The tenant then successfully sued the previous tenant for possession. The tenant did not inform the landlord of the eviction action until after the tenant received possession.
The tenant then sued the landlord, claiming damages for that portion of the lease period during which the tenant was not in possession.
If the court finds for the landlord, what will be the most likely explanation?

choices.A: By suing the previous tenant for possession, the tenant elected that remedy in lieu of a suit against the landlord.
choices.B: The landlord had delivered the legal right of possession to the tenant.
choices.C: The tenant failed to timely vacate as required to sue for constructive eviction.
choices.D: The tenant had not notified the landlord before bringing the eviction action.

questions.explanation:
Landlord's duty to deliver possession
Requirements Remedies for breach
English rule
(majority)		 Deliver actual possession to tenant - ie, remove third party who wrongfully possesses property
  • Withhold rent to acquire possession
  • Seek damages for period not in possession
  • Terminate lease
American rule
(minority)		 Deliver legal possession to tenant - ie, ensure that no third party has a right to possess property

A landlord must generally deliver actual possession of leased premises to the tenant at the start of the lease term - ie, by removing any third party who wrongfully possesses the property (eg, a holdover tenant). If the landlord fails to do so, the tenant can recover damages from the landlord for the time when the tenant was not in possession. However, a minority of jurisdictions only require a landlord to deliver legal possession - ie, by ensuring that no third party has a right to possess the property when the lease term begins.

Here, the landlord leased property to the tenant for six months beginning on July 1. When the tenant arrived at the leased premises on July 1, he learned that the previous tenant had not vacated the premises (ie, the landlord failed to deliver actual possession). And since the previous tenant's lease ended on May 31, she was a holdover tenant who had no right to possess the property on July 1. Therefore, the most likely reason for a finding in the landlord's favor is that this court follows the minority rule and the landlord had delivered legal possession to the tenant.

(Choices A & D) A tenant does not waive any claim against the landlord by (1) suing a third party (eg, the previous tenant) for possession of the premises or (2) failing to notify the landlord before evicting the third party. As a result, the court will not find for the landlord on either basis.

(Choice C) To sue a landlord for constructive eviction - a landlord's substantial interference with a tenant's permissible use and enjoyment of the property - the tenant must notify the landlord and then vacate the premises within a reasonable time. But a failure to vacate does not prevent a tenant from suing based on the landlord's failure to deliver possession, so the court likely would not find in the landlord's favor on this basis.

📌 Educational Objective

Although a landlord must generally deliver actual possession of the leased premises to the tenant at the beginning of the lease term, a minority of jurisdictions only require the landlord to deliver legal possession.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant § 6.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (landlord's duty to deliver possession).

当租户于7月1日到达租赁物业时，他得知前租户在5月31日租期结束后并未搬离该物业，且无意搬离。该租户随后成功起诉前租户，要求获得占有权。在该租户获得占有权之后，他才将此驱逐诉讼告知房东。

如果法院作出有利于房东的裁决，最可能的解释是什么？

zh-choices.A: 通过起诉前租户以获得占有权，租户选择了该救济方式，以替代对房东的诉讼。
zh-choices.B: 房东已向租户交付了占有的合法权利。
zh-choices.C: 租户未能按照推定驱逐诉讼的要求及时搬离。

本题真正考的是：房东在租期开始时到底要交付 实际占有（actual possession） 还是只要交付 合法占有（legal possession）。

三秒认题路径：

租期开始 → 前租客赖着不走 → 先看州规则 → 多数要实际占有 → 少数只要合法占有

核心法律规则

一般规则下，房东要在租期开始时交付 实际占有（actual possession），也就是把无权占房的第三人赶走。美国规则（American rule） 是少数规则，考场意思：房东只要保证租期开始时没有第三人有权占有即可。

这题里，前租客在 5 月 31 日后仍赖着不走，所以房东没有交付实际占有；但如果法院采少数州规则，只要求 合法占有（legal possession），因为前租客已经没有权利继续占房，房东就可能胜诉。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord & Tenant § 6.2 — 它把本题锁定成“多数看实际占有，少数看合法占有”的选择题。

思维导图

租期开始时，房东交付了什么？
题干事实 前租客 7 月 1 日还占着房子，租客自己把前租客告走。
多数规则 实际占有（actual possession）：要把无权第三人赶走。
本题卡点：前租客没搬走 → 多数州下房东违约；但少数州只看 合法占有（legal possession）。
少数规则 前租客已无权占有 → 房东可只交付合法占有 → 选 B。
排除误区 A / D 不是关键：自己起诉前租客、没先通知房东，都不等于放弃对房东的索赔。
排除误区 C 说的是 constructive eviction，那套“通知 + 及时搬离”的规则，不是本题的“交付占有”问题。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：前租客霸占房子这么明显，房东当然输了，而且租客还自己去告前租客，好像会“自己选了别的救济”。

但考试真正问的是：房东在这类州到底要交付的是哪一种占有；不是看租客后来有没有先把前租客赶走，也不是看他有没有先通知房东。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。 这题的关键不是故事谁更委屈，而是州法采多数还是少数规则。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干的 前租客 7 月 1 日仍占房 说明房东没交付实际占有；但法院若采少数州规则，只要合法占有，房东就能胜诉。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把 elected that remedy 当成放弃对房东的权利了。

❌ 法律适用 | 驱逐要件误判

✕ C: 把 constructive eviction 的“通知+搬离”硬套进来。

❌ 事实误判 | 通知时点偷换

✕ D: 先告前租客不等于必须先通知房东。

这题建议用什么方法？

先判定州法要求的是实际占有还是合法占有，再把“自己告前租客”“没先通知房东”这些干扰信息全部后放。

考场速记

记忆口诀：多数州看 actual possession，少数州只看 legal possession。 看到房东交屋纠纷，先问“前租客是不是还在”，再问“本州是多数还是少数”。
